correctness.rationale: The line graph of the cube has twelve vertices, each representing one cube edge; a face belongs to F_d exactly when every selected vertex has ≤d selected neighbors for d=0,1, equivalent to components of size at most d+1. Independent full 4096-mask enumeration gives F0 108 and F1 456 faces, matching the source vectors. Entire augmented face-poset matchings have 52 and 212 pairs respectively, four critical 2-cells and thirty-two critical 3-cells; directed Hasse topological sorts prove acyclicity, giving integral sphere wedges. The inclusion ∨4S²→∨32S³ is null since the target is 2-connected; quotient cofiber of a null cofibration gives ∨36S³. Our independent full face and Hasse DAG computations verify both critical matchings; field ranks alone would not prove integral homotopy.
residual_risks: Only the 12-vertex cuboctahedron and stages F0,F1 are covered, not higher stages or arbitrary line graphs.
